jobs.title: Director, Finance Systems & ERP
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture. Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

Financial Systems Engineering owns and evolves the technology ecosystem that powers Smartsheet’s financial operations and monetization capabilities. The team is responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, and supporting technologies such as Avalara, along with the integrations, data, automation, and engineering capabilities that connect these platforms across the enterprise.

As Director, Finance Systems & ERP, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Smartsheet’s financial technology ecosystem and define the long-term technical strategy for how these platforms evolve. You will own the architecture, engineering maturity, technical health, and delivery of systems supporting core financial operations, procurement, planning, payments, billing, revenue processes, and emerging monetization models.

This is a strategic and highly visible technology leadership role. You will lead major transformation initiatives including ERP modernization, billing transformation, and the evolution toward usage-based and consumption-based monetization. You will represent Corporate Systems in executive steering committees and major transformation programs, partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, and other technology leaders.

You will partner closely with Product Managers across Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to combine business and product strategy with a forward-looking technical strategy. You will be expected to challenge legacy architectures and operating models, identify opportunities to simplify and automate financial processes, and determine how modern software engineering, enterprise data, automation, and AI can improve how Finance technology operates.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Systems and collaborate closely with Product and Engineering leaders across the organization.

You Will:

  • Own the technical strategy and long-term architecture for Smartsheet’s financial systems ecosystem across ERP, procurement, financial planning, payments, billing, tax, revenue processes, integrations, data, automation, and AI
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Financial Systems Engineering organization responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, and associated technologies
  • Serve as the senior technology leader for NetSuite and ERP, ensuring the platform and surrounding architecture remain scalable, maintainable, secure, auditable, and aligned with the long-term needs of a complex SaaS business
  • Provide technology leadership for major Finance transformation programs, including ERP reimplementation and modernization, establishing architecture, engineering standards, technical governance, delivery practices, and long-term platform direction
  • Partner with Product Managers for Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to translate product strategy and business priorities into technical roadmaps, architecture, investment decisions, and executable engineering plans
  • Shape the technology architecture required to support evolving SaaS monetization models, including subscription, multi-year, usage-based, consumption-based, and AI-related pricing and billing models
  • Partner across Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Finance, and Corporate Systems to ensure pricing and packaging strategies can be represented reliably from quote and entitlement through provisioning, usage, billing, accounting, and revenue processes
  • Establish clear architectural boundaries and systems of record across CRM, product, billing, ERP, payments, tax, planning, and downstream data platforms, reducing ambiguity, duplication, and unnecessary coupling
  • Define the strategy for Finance systems data, including authoritative sources, data models, data contracts, quality, lineage, reconciliation, historical integrity, and reliable consumption by the enterprise data platform
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to integrate Financial Systems with the enterprise data lake and ensure Finance data is timely, trustworthy, well-defined, and usable for financial reporting, operational analytics, reconciliation, and AI
  • Drive stronger data quality and observability across Quote-to-Cash and Finance workflows, moving the organization from reactive reconciliation toward proactive detection and prevention of data integrity issues
  • Establish an AI strategy for Financial Systems Engineering, identifying practical opportunities to improve engineering productivity, financial operations, controls, testing, support, reconciliation, and employee experiences
  • Evaluate and introduce AI-assisted and agentic capabilities where appropriate, while ensuring financial integrity, security, auditability, human oversight, and appropriate controls for higher-risk processes
  • Develop a strategy for automated testing and quality engineering across the Finance technology stack, including regression testing, integration testing, data validation, reconciliation, and AI-assisted test generation and analysis
  • Establish modern engineering practices across enterprise platforms, including source control, peer review, CI/CD, environment management, automated testing, observability, documentation, release engineering, and operational readiness where supported by the underlying technologies
  • Determine appropriate boundaries between native SaaS configuration, platform extensibility, APIs, integrations, automation, and custom software, avoiding unnecessary customization while enabling capabilities the business requires
  • Partner with Integration Engineering to ensure critical Finance and Quote-to-Cash integrations use scalable patterns, explicit contracts, appropriate observability, resilient error handling, and well-defined operational ownership
  • Own the technical health and lifecycle of the Financial Systems portfolio, proactively addressing architectural debt, platform limitations, fragile integrations, unnecessary customization, manual processes, and recurring operational problems
  • Establish architecture reviews, technical standards, engineering metrics, platform health reviews, and other mechanisms that continuously improve the maturity of Financial Systems Engineering
  • Represent Financial Systems Engineering on executive steering committees, transformation governance forums, and major program reviews, clearly communicating architecture decisions, delivery status, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and tradeoffs
  • Provide technical leadership across implementation partners and strategic vendors, ensuring system integrators and software providers operate within Smartsheet’s architecture, engineering, security, and delivery expectations rather than allowing vendors to define the long-term architecture
  • Partner with Finance leadership, Accounting, FP&A, Procurement, Tax, Revenue, and other stakeholders to understand business strategy while maintaining clear technology ownership of architecture and engineering decisions
  • Balance delivery of major transformation programs with operational reliability, roadmap commitments, technical debt reduction, platform modernization, security, controls, and long-term engineering investments
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, Security, AI & Automation, and Corporate Systems to ensure Financial Systems operate as part of a coherent enterprise architecture
  • Recruit, develop, and retain engineering talent with a combination of Finance platform expertise, software engineering capability, systems thinking, and curiosity about the future of financial technology

You Have:

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience across financial systems, enterprise application engineering, ERP, software engineering, systems architecture, or related technical disciplines
  • 5+ years of experience leading technical teams, including experience managing managers, senior engineers, architects, or other technical leaders
  • Deep experience with NetSuite or comparable enterprise ERP platforms, with sufficient technical depth to lead architecture, challenge implementation decisions, and establish long-term platform strategy
  • Demonstrated experience leading a major ERP implementation, reimplementation, or transformation program from architecture and design through implementation, stabilization, and ongoing evolution
  • Strong understanding of financial business processes including record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, billing, payments, financial planning, accounting, and revenue-related workflows
  • Experience with financial platforms such as Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, or comparable ERP, procurement, planning, payments, billing, tax, or monetization technologies
  • Experience with SaaS billing and monetization architectures, including subscription and usage-based or consumption-based business models
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason across ERP, CRM, product, billing, payments, integrations, data platforms, APIs, automation, and financial controls as a connected architecture
  • Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy and architecture, rather than solely managing enterprise application delivery, configuration, implementation partners, or support
  • Experience designing or evolving enterprise data architecture, including systems of record, data models, interfaces, contracts, quality, reconciliation, governance, lineage, and downstream consumption
  • Experience partnering with enterprise Data Engineering or Analytics organizations and integrating operational systems with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar enterprise data technologies
  • Experience establishing modern engineering practices within enterprise application environments, including automated testing, CI/CD, source control, observability, release management, documentation, and operational readiness
  • Understanding of modern AI capabilities and the ability to identify practical applications of LLMs, agents, and intelligent automation while appropriately managing financial, security, and compliance risk
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, auditability, security, data integrity, and compliance considerations associated with business-critical financial platforms
  • Experience governing system integrators and technology vendors during large transformation programs, including the ability to challenge proposed architectures and hold partners accountable for engineering quality
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers and senior business leaders to combine business strategy, product strategy, and technical strategy into coherent roadmaps and investment decisions
  • Ability to operate comfortably from executive steering committee discussions to detailed architecture reviews, translating effectively between business executives, Finance leaders, Product Managers, engineers, architects, and implementation partners
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge legacy processes and architectures constructively and lead organizations through significant technology and operating-model change
  • Excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills, with demonstrated executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technology decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Business, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range

$175,000—$290,000 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Hardware Quality
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

At Oura, our mission is to empower every person to own their inner potential. With our award-winning Oura Ring and app, we help millions of people turn insights about sleep, activity, and readiness into healthier, more balanced lives.We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to partner with Oura’s Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Support Engineering, and Finance teams. This role will help build the data science and decision systems that make Oura hardware more reliable, from early product testing and launch readiness through field performance, warranty outcomes, and long-term product improvement.You will work on some of the most important problems in consumer hardware: understanding why products fail, predicting reliability before issues reach members, connecting manufacturing and testing data to field outcomes, and turning complex engineering data into clear decisions. This is a full-stack applied data science role that combines data foundations, statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and cross-functional technical leadership.

What You Will Do:

  • Build and evolve reliability and quality models for current and next-generation Oura Ring products, including warranty forecasts, runtime degradation, survival analysis, failure-mode prediction, and cohort-based field-performance analysis.
  • Develop diagnostics and root-cause analysis systems that connect ring telemetry, firmware and engineering diagnostics, manufacturing records, supplier and component data, testing results, activations, and warranty outcomes.
  • Partner with Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Battery Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Support Engineering to identify the highest-leverage reliability risks and translate them into measurable analytical problems.
  • Analyze component, supplier, manufacturing-process, and ring-build variation to identify drivers of product quality and inform corrective actions, design decisions, and supplier-quality improvements.
  • Build trusted analytical data products and pipelines that unify hardware, manufacturing, firmware, diagnostic, activation, and warranty data and make them usable for recurring analysis and decision-making.
  • Develop production AI-enhanced dashboards, monitoring, and decision-support tools that surface emerging failure risks and provide clear, actionable recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Establish robust measurement practices for hardware quality, including metric definitions, cohorting, normalization, uncertainty, data-quality checks, and appropriate statistical methods.
  • Translate complex technical findings into concise recommendations that influence hardware roadmaps, launch decisions, quality plans, firmware priorities, warranty strategy, and member experience.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional problems and help raise the bar for data science practices through documentation, peer review, reusable tooling, and mentorship.

This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco.

What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, reliability engineering, quality analytics, or a closely related quantitative field, with a track record of owning high-impact problems end to end.
  • Demonstrated experience applying statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, or advanced analytics to reliability, quality, manufacturing, hardware, IoT, electronics, automotive, medical devices, or another physical-product domain.
  • Strong experience with reliability and time-to-event methods, such as survival analysis, hazard modeling, accelerated-life testing, degradation modeling, warranty forecasting, or related techniques.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building analytical data models, statistical or machine-learning workflows, and production-quality measurement systems.
  • Strong data-engineering intuition, including experience unifying and transforming data from multiple operational and technical systems into reliable datasets for analysis and modeling.
  • Experience working with noisy, incomplete, longitudinal, or high-volume telemetry and test data, and the judgment to distinguish data artifacts from meaningful product signals.
  • Experience designing experiments or observational analyses that support technical decisions, including an understanding of confounding, bias, uncertainty, and validation.
  • Experience with modern cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, AWS, dbt, Snowflake, or similar tools.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to engineers, quality and operations partners, product leaders, and executives.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across distributed, cross-functional teams and to drive progress when requirements and data are still evolving.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with consumer electronics, wearables, IoT, batteries, embedded systems, firmware, sensors, or connected devices.
  • Experience analyzing manufacturing, supplier, component traceability, MES, ERP, engineering test, or warranty data.
  • Experience with battery degradation, runtime modeling, charging optimization, power management, or electronics reliability.
  • Experience building field-failure analysis, anomaly detection, predictive-maintenance, or early-warning systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware development and launch processes, including EVT, DVT, PVT, and field-test programs.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave

Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

jobs.title: Principal + Staff Software Engineers
jobs.description:
Unstructured is defining the standard for enterprise data transformation in the age of LLMs and generative AI. In just two years, we've raised over $65M from world-class investors, including Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital, Databricks, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and IBM.

Our open-source toolkit has been downloaded 97M+ times and is used by 90% of the Fortune 1000. We power production AI workflows across commercial and federal sectors — transforming PDFs, HTML, Word docs, images, emails, and more into AI-ready data pipelines that scale.

We're not just building tools; we're building the backbone of generative AI and the infrastructure that unlocks intelligence across industries.

About the Role

Unstructured is looking for Staff and Principal Software Engineers to define the architectural foundation for how enterprises process and transform unstructured data for large-language-model (LLM) applications.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who thrives in deep systems work—someone who could write the book on Kubernetes, lives and breathes Python, and understands Postgres at the index and transaction-log level. You’ll own the technical direction for our core platform, guiding how data moves through every layer—from ingestion to transformation to retrieval.

You’ll partner closely with the Head of Engineering, Head of Infrastructure, and product leaders to ensure Unstructured’s systems are performant, resilient, and ready to support the next generation of AI-driven workloads.

Location(s) Preferred: San Francisco, Bay Area, San Jose, Seattle, Sacramento

What You’ll Own & Drive

  • Define and evolve the end-to-end architecture for Unstructured’s data transformation and retrieval platform.

  • Build and scale distributed systems that process massive volumes of unstructured data across diverse formats and sources.

  • Serve as the company-wide authority on Kubernetes orchestration, cluster design, performance tuning, and reliability.

  • Lead Python architecture and best practices—ensuring performance, modularity, and maintainability across services.

  • Design and optimize Postgres schemas, queries, and indexing strategies to support large-scale metadata and retrieval pipelines.

  • Mentor senior engineers through design reviews and code guidance, raising the bar for technical excellence across the org.

  • Partner with the infrastructure and product teams to translate research prototypes into production-grade systems.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and open-source tools in LLM infrastructure, retrieval, and orchestration—deciding where and how to integrate them.

What We're Looking for

  • Have 10+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on distributed systems, infrastructure, or data architecture.

  • Are a Python expert—capable of building frameworks and performance-critical services from scratch.

  • Have deep Kubernetes expertise; you can design, deploy, and debug at scale and could teach others how to productionize it securely.

  • Are fluent in Postgres—you understand query planning, partitioning, and tuning for high-throughput environments.

  • Are obsessed with clean, scalable architecture and can lead design reviews that shape how entire systems evolve.

  • Have experience in high-performance data or AI/ML systems—especially those involving retrieval pipelines, embeddings, or hybrid workloads.

  • Thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where technical depth and judgment matter more than process.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building or scaling LLM-powered or RAG systems in production.

  • Familiarity with open-source orchestration frameworks, vector databases, or hybrid cloud infrastructure.

  • Contributions to open-source projects in Python, Kubernetes, or distributed systems.

Why You’ll Love It Here

You’ll be surrounded by smart, kind, low-ego people who genuinely enjoy building together. We invest in our team with company offsites, best-in-tech swag, and the tools you need to do your best work, wherever you’re based.

We support you holistically, not just at work. For full-time, US-based employees, that includes:

  • Health: Medical, dental, and vision coverage through Justworks, effective the 1st of the month following your start date. All medical plans include fertility coverage, plus access to One Medical, Talkspace (12 free therapy sessions a year), Kindbody, and Teladoc. If you waive medical coverage, we pay a $250/month allowance.

  • Financial: 401(k) with company match (100% of the first 3% you contribute, 50% of the next 2%), company-paid life insurance, and optional supplemental life, short- and long-term disability, accident, critical illness, and hospital coverage. FSA and HSA options available.

  • Equity: Stock options, so you share in what we’re building.

  • Time off: Flexible paid time off (unlimited), up to 80 hours of paid sick leave a year, 12 company holidays, and a company-wide winter break between Christmas and New Year’s.

  • Family: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents, available after 6 months, plus up to 6 additional unpaid weeks.

  • Remote setup: A $500 home office stipend and a $75/month cell and internet stipend.

  • Team: Team and company offsites throughout the year.

We want you focused on building, growing, and staying energized for the long haul. If you’re excited about what we’re building, we’d love to meet you.

Unstructured is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture where everyone can do their best work. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Databases - Analytics | UK | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.

The Opportunity:

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.

The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. You will design and ship the core backend architecture that powers ingestion, context storage, retrieval APIs, and agent-facing integrations. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Build the core backend services: Design, implement, test, and operate the first services for context ingestion, context indexing, retrieval orchestration, API access, source configuration, and system administration.
  • Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
  • Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and service interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve relevant context, provenance, confidence signals, and warnings.
  • Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
  • Operate what you build: Instrument services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
  • Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
  • Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
  • Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.
  • Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
  • Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.
  • Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.
  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and building applications powered by GenAI.
  • Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.
  • Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience building or working with agent frameworks or multi‑agent workflows.
  • Experience as a data analyst or work with data platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Snowflake, DataBricks)
  • Experience building tools for data engineering.

How we work:

We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our Staff engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 103,958 - GBP 124,750. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. jobs.title: Field CTO
jobs.description:
The Field CTO is the most senior technical voice in the field. Here's the version we're hiring for.

The Field CTO sits a level above the Solution Architect. Where the SA leads the technical strategy on complex deals, the Field CTO owns the technical narrative across the territory, shapes how the market understands Sigma's architecture, and carries the credibility to win the room when the CTO, CDO, and CISO are all in it. This person does everything a senior SA does, then operates a tier higher: as a peer to enterprise executives, a force multiplier across the entire Solution Engineering team, and a direct line back into Product and Engineering.

Three things sit at the center of this role. The Field CTO does all three at the highest level, with the architectural depth and executive presence to back it up.

1. Use AI every day, and set the standard for how the team uses it.

The Field CTO treats AI tooling as default infrastructure and raises the bar for everyone else. You run Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or equivalents to compress account prep, architecture design, prototype builds, RFP responses, and discovery synthesis from weeks into days. You bring a clear point of view on what to run, why, and where it breaks. You don't just use these tools well. You teach the SE and SA teams how to use them better, and you build the workflows the rest of the field adopts.

2. Sell AI into the account at the executive level.

Buyers want to talk about agents, MCP, A2A, context engineering, and which model powers what. You're fluent, and you can take that conversation to the most senior technical buyer in the building. You know Sigma's AI surface cold: Sigma Assistant in build, analyze, and plan modes, AI functions, input tables with LLM enrichment, MCP integration, Sigma agents, and warehouse agents. You architect these into a customer's stack, defend the tradeoffs to a head of data and a CISO in the same call, and frame the long-term AI strategy for a CTO who's deciding where to place a multi-year bet. You speak credibly about Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and the broader stack the customer already runs.

3. Sell against AI, and own the position the whole team runs.

Every enterprise deal has AI competition in it. Sometimes it's Databricks Genie. Sometimes it's Snowflake Cortex Analyst. Sometimes it's a systems integrator pitching a bespoke agent built over a weekend. You know where each one breaks at scale, where Sigma's warehouse-native architecture wins on governance, freshness, and cost, and how to draw that line for a skeptical CDO without hand-waving. You defend that position in an architecture review, on a security questionnaire, and across a six-month evaluation. Then you turn what you learn into the competitive teardowns and battlecards the entire field uses.

About Sigma

Sigma is the AI runtime environment for the modern enterprise. Teams build apps, agents, and analytics directly in Sigma, with governance and security inherited from the cloud data warehouse. No extracts, no separate AI pipelines, no shadow stack to maintain.

About the role

The Field CTO is the senior-most technical leader in the field organization. You partner with Solution Architects, Solution Engineers, and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers on the largest and most strategic enterprise opportunities, the ones that hinge on architecture, AI strategy, governance, or executive trust. Your job is to win the technical decision at the top of the account and to make the whole team better at winning it.

You'll work across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll carry real influence in all of them. Prospects and customers will come to you as a peer to their own technical leadership. Internally, you'll shape product direction, mentor the SA and SE teams, and represent Sigma's architecture and AI runtime story to the market.

What you'll do

  • Own the technical narrative across the territory's most strategic accounts, partnered with the SAs and SEs working those deals.
  • Lead executive-level architecture and AI strategy conversations with CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, and their senior technical teams.
  • Run deep technical discovery and architecture workshops, and step in to unblock the opportunities no one else can move.
  • Design and build production-grade prototypes and custom apps that prove out high-value use cases, including Sigma plugins, fully code-backed data apps, and AI-driven workflows using Sigma Assistant, Sigma agents, warehouse agents, and MCP integrations. You build in HTML, JavaScript, and Python, both natively in Sigma and as warehouse stored procedures.
  • Lead the hardest security architecture conversations: PrivateLink, OAuth, SAML, SCIM, and the governance model behind them.
  • Present Sigma's architecture and AI runtime story externally: analyst briefings, executive roundtables, conference stages, and CTO-to-CTO conversations.
  • Own the technical position on the hardest RFPs, RFIs, AI risk reviews, and security questionnaires.
  • Advise on integration, migration, governance, and AI patterns across Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, and Redshift.
  • Set Sigma's competitive position against Databricks AI/BI and Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, and AI-native entrants. Defend it with architecture, not slogans, and turn it into reusable assets for the team.
  • Build the SA and SE playbook and the programs the field runs on: architecture patterns, AI-workflow playbooks, competitive teardowns, reference implementations, demo-build prompts, and a repeatable technical-win process.
  • Package domain expertise into reusable industry assets across verticals like financial services, insurance, and gaming, so a single deal's learnings compound across the territory.
  • Shape the product from the front line. Carry field intel directly to Product and Engineering leadership, write up customer patterns, secure early feature access, and influence the roadmap across the AI surface.
  • Mentor SAs and SEs. Raise the technical bar of the team and accelerate the next hire's ramp.
  • Run several strategic enterprise engagements at once across the territory.
  • Earn and maintain product, sales, and technology certifications.
  • Hit quarterly and annual targets set by your manager.

What we're looking for

Technical depth. 12+ years in business intelligence, analytics engineering, or data platform roles, with at least 5 in a customer-facing technical leadership role (SA, Field CTO, principal SE, or senior consulting). Deep expertise in at least one cloud data warehouse: Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift, and working fluency across the rest. Strong SQL and a deep command of modern data architecture: warehousing, modeling, governance, security.

Data engineering fluency. Hands-on experience with ETL and transformation tooling like dbt, Fivetran, Matillion, or comparable, and the judgment to architect across them.

Builder's depth. You write working code, not just diagrams. Comfortable in HTML, JavaScript, and Python, building custom apps, plugins, and AI workflows end to end, both inside the product and against the warehouse.

Security architecture. Deep command of enterprise security and identity patterns: PrivateLink, OAuth, SAML, SCIM, and the governance decisions that ride on them. You lead these conversations with a CISO, not defer them.

AI fluency at the leading edge. Daily user of modern AI tools and a credible voice on agents, MCP, A2A, context engineering, retrieval, evals, and the major model providers. You position Sigma's AI stack against warehouse agents like Genie and Cortex Analyst, and against AI-native BI entrants, without hand-waving, and you set the team's point of view.

Enterprise selling. Track record of leading and closing the most complex enterprise sales cycles or large BI implementations. You know how to partner with AEs, SAs, and SEs, and how to win the technical decision at the executive level.

Executive presence. You hold a CTO and a data engineer in the same room without switching gears awkwardly. You lead the architecture review, the boardroom briefing, and the conference keynote, and you're the person customers call when the decision is theirs to make.

Pace and energy. You operate well in a high-velocity environment. Self-starter. No hand-holding.

Team fit. You want a team that sharpens each other, and you make everyone around you better. You bring field intel back. You build the playbooks and own the next hire's ramp. Ego stays out of the room.

Education. Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience.

Travel. Willingness to travel up to 35%.

About us:

Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase.

Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year.

Come join us!

Benefits For Our Full-Time Employees:

  • Equity
  • Generous health benefits
  • Flexible time off policy. Take the time off you need!
  • Paid bonding time for all new parents
  • Traditional and Roth 401k
  • Commuter and FSA benefits
  • Lunch Program
  • Dog friendly office

Sigma is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a smart and strong team regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran, or any other protected status. We look forward to learning how your experience can enable all of us to grow.

Note: We have an in-office work environment in all our offices in SF, NYC, London and Sydney. All roles have a 25% travel expectation unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Our Privacy Practices

When you submit a job application on this site, Sigma processes your personal data for the purposes of evaluating your candidacy for employment at Sigma and as otherwise needed throughout the recruitment and hiring process. Please review Sigma’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more details. Please note that your personal data may be transferred to a country other than the one in which it was provided (including to the USA, the UK, and Canada, Australia).

Sigma’s use of AI

This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

jobs.title: Senior AI Developer, Data
jobs.description:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent, our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate, the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

At Workleap, turning AI experiments into production capabilities is already part of how we build products and improve internal operations. Our Data team brings strong data engineering and science foundations; this role adds dedicated production AI engineering. As a Senior AI Developer, you'll design, build, and operate the AI systems and agentic workflows that connect foundation models to our data, tools, and applications, and you'll set the technical direction for how we do it well.

Your impact:

  • Ship production AI systems and agentic workflows that deliver measurable value in Workleap's products and internal operations.
  • Own the production quality of those systems: observability, testing, security, and cost built in from the start.
  • Turn evaluation evidence from Data Scientists into engineering improvements, so we know whether a system is getting better or worse.
  • Engineer the context integrations that let agents use governed data and application capabilities accurately.
  • Define reusable patterns and components so the next team starts from a working foundation, not a blank page.
  • Drive architecture decisions across quality, risk, and cost, and make the trade-offs explicit.

Your team

You'll join Workleap's Shared Tech - Data team, a hands-on team of six Data Engineers and Data Scientists responsible for the data and AI foundations supporting our products and internal teams. We value technical judgment, pragmatism, simplicity, autonomy, collaboration, and reliable delivery. You'll work closely with both disciplines and partner with Software Engineers, Product teams, and Platform and Security specialists to bring AI capabilities into production.

Over the next 6-12 months, you'll work on questions like: how does someone ask an analytical question of governed data and get an answer they can trust? How do we know an AI agent is good enough to take on more responsibility? How do we run AI features with the same rigor as any other critical system?

Our technology ecosystem includes Python, SQL, Snowflake (Cortex, Cortex Agents, Cortex Code), Claude, OpenAI, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry, Terraform, and GitHub.

What you'll bring

  • Strong production engineering in Python and SQL, with testing, CI/CD, and experience operating cloud systems;
  • Hands-on experience building and operating AI applications with foundation models, agents, tools, and context;
  • Experience instrumenting and evaluating non-deterministic systems: observability, evals, regression testing;
  • Sound architectural judgment across reliability, security, and cost, and the confidence to form and defend a technical opinion;
  • Experience building components or tooling that other developers adopt;
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake and its AI capabilities (Cortex), or the ability to ramp up on them quickly;
  • A builder mindset: you own what you ship, experiment quickly, and use AI-assisted development tools daily and critically;
  • Bonus: AI services on Azure, AWS, or GCP, or developer platforms that accelerate AI adoption across teams.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $140 000 - $170 000. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
  • Annual bonus program.
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gatherings twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy.

jobs.description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

jobs.description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! 

 

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

 

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing  #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!


Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!


The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. 

This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates.
  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.
  • Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes
  • Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset.
  • Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts.
  • A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation.
  • FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. 
  • Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. 
  • Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. 
  • Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 


\n

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos

Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

  • Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer & Consultant (all genders) – Microsoft Fabric
jobs.description:
Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen.

Als Teil der teccle group steht die teccle wave für ganzheitliche Cloud-Lösungen und digitale Transformation im deutschen Mittelstand. Zur Verstärkung unseres eigenständigen siebenköpfigen Data-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte Unterstützung.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei:

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Data-&-Analytics-Plattformen auf Basis von Microsoft Fabric, Azure und Power BI, um nachhaltige Mehrwerte für unsere Kund:innen zu schaffen

  • Aufbau skalierbarer Datenarchitekturen, Datenmodelle und Data Pipelines, die eine effiziente Integration, Aufbereitung und Nutzung von Unternehmensdaten ermöglichen

  • Verantwortung für die technische Konzeption und erfolgreiche Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Kundenprojekte – von der Analyse über Workshops bis zur Qualitätssicherung

  • Sicherstellung leistungsfähiger Reporting-, BI- und Self-Service-Analytics-Lösungen, die datengetriebene Entscheidungen auf allen Ebenen unterstützen

  • Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen, Stakeholdern und Projektteams, um Projekte effizient, transparent und zielgerichtet zum Erfolg zu führen

  • Einsatz innovativer Technologien wie Azure AI und Microsoft Foundry zur Erweiterung moderner Datenplattformen und AI-gestützter Analytics-Lösungen

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Data-, Analytics- oder Cloud-Umfeld mit – idealerweise im Consulting oder in kundenorientierten Projektlandschaften – und verfügst über fundiertes Know-how in Microsoft Fabric, Azure, OneLake, Data Lakes und modernen Datenarchitekturen

  • Du entwickelst, betreibst und optimierst skalierbare Cloud Data Platforms, ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Data Pipelines mit Microsoft Fabric, Python, SQL sowie modernen CI/CD- und Testing-Standards

  • Du besitzt Erfahrung in Data Engineering, Datenmodellierung, Lösungsarchitektur und Systemintegration; Kenntnisse in Power BI, Spark/PySpark, Azure AI, AI Foundry oder komplexen SaaS-Anbindungen sind ein zusätzliches Plus

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und kundenorientiert, kommunizierst sicher mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern und überzeugst im agilen Projektumfeld mit professionellem Auftreten

  • Du interessierst dich für innovative Technologien, moderne AI- und Analytics-Lösungen sowie technische Projektverantwortung; Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wie DP-600, DP-700, AZ-305 oder AI-102 sind willkommen

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Deutschland und bist berechtigt hier zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Ob im Büro oder von zuhause - du entscheidest, was für dich am besten funktioniert

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Strukturen

  • Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Gehalt, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.
Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.
